message.content:
This editorial illustration features the cover of "TEMPO" magazine. At the top, the title "TEMPO" is printed in large, black, serif capital letters, with the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" below it. The main imagery consists of a human face, positioned at the bottom and tilted backward so the underside of the chin and the neck face upward. From the center of the person’s nose, a tall industrial smokestack emerges vertically. The smokestack is cylindrical with red and white horizontal stripes at the top, and dark grey smoke billows from its peak, drifting behind the "M" and "P" of the title.

Bold red text overlaid on the center reads "MANGKUS MERINGKUS IDRUS". Below this, smaller black text mentions "IDRUS MARHAM" and "SUAP PABRIK LISTRIK". Other headlines at the very top include "POLITIK MUTASI DI MABES POLRI," "MELIANA MELIANA," and "KISRUH BANTUAN GEMPA LOMBOK." The background is a plain off-white color. A barcode and pricing information are located in the bottom right corner. A solid red vertical border runs along the left edge.
